title: Time
description: Class 3 IMO — Time: reading clocks (hour, half-hour, quarter-hour), hours and minutes, converting hours to minutes, days, months, leap year, elapsed time and the calendar.

topics.title: Reading the Clock
topics.concept:
A clock has a short hour hand and a long minute hand. When the minute hand points to 12 it is an o'clock time; to 3 it is quarter past (15 minutes); to 6 it is half past (30 minutes); and to 9 it is quarter to the next hour (45 minutes).

There are 60 minutes in 1 hour.

examples.problem: The minute hand is on 3 and the hour hand just past 4. What time is it?

recap: Quarter past = 15 min; half past = 30 min; quarter to = 45 min.

quiz.q: Quarter past 4 is the same as ___ ?
How many minutes are there in 1 hour?

topics.title: Hours, Minutes, Days & Months
topics.concept: To change hours to minutes, multiply by 60. So 2 hours = 120 minutes. A week has 7 days, and a year has 12 months and 365 days. A leap year has 366 days because February has 29 days instead of 28.

examples.problem: How many days does a leap year have?

recap: Year = 12 months = 365 days; leap year = 366 days.

quiz.q: How many days are there in a week?

topics.title: Elapsed Time & the Calendar
topics.concept: Elapsed time is how long something lasts — the time from the start to the end. If an activity starts at 9:00 and lasts 3 hours, it ends at 12:00. We also use a calendar to find dates, days and how many days are between two dates.

examples.problem: A class starts at 9:00 and lasts 3 hours. When does it end?
A film runs from 2:30 to 4:30. How long is it?

recap: Elapsed time = end time − start time.
Use the calendar to count days between dates.

quiz.q: A match starts at 5 o'clock and lasts 4 hours. When does it end?

quiz.explanation: 60 minutes is 1 hour, plus 30 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes.

questions.q: Half past 7 is the same as ___ ?
Which is the odd one out (three are days of the week)?
questions.explanation: March is a month; the others are days.

questions.q: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 3 days?
Quarter to 9 is the same as ___ ?
questions.explanation: Quarter to 9 means 15 minutes before 9, so 8:45.

questions.q: How many minutes are there in half an hour?
How many days are there in a year that is not a leap year?
School begins at 8 o'clock and runs for 6 hours. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 8 + 6 = 14, which is 2 o'clock in the afternoon.

questions.q: A cartoon runs from 4:00 to 4:45. How long is it?
A train is due at 10:00 but is 2 hours late. When does it arrive?
How many months of the year have 31 days?
questions.explanation: January, March, May, July, August, October and December — that is 7 months.

questions.q: How long is it from 9:30 to 11:00?
questions.explanation: 9:30 to 10:30 is 1 hour, plus 30 minutes to 11:00 = 1 hour 30 minutes.
